text:
maria: Heads up — prod saw a short spike (18:12 UTC) that produced a flurry of 503s for ~40s. Looks like per-key token buckets depleted quickly while per-org stayed okay. Can we discuss tolerating microbursts without opening the floodgates? cc @sam @liam

sam: Saw it too. p95 latency rose but CPU/memory were fine. RPS spiked ~6x for <1m. Per-org buckets mostly fine, single API keys hit hard and got rejected.

liam: Do we know current token settings? I think it's rate=10r/s, burst=30 tokens for most keys (short_window=60s). SDKs that fan out will definitely bust that.

anita: From previous threads — token bucket + leaky smoothing tradeoffs. Idea: keep token bucket but add a very short in-memory 'grace queue' (bounded) that absorbs microbursts, then fast-drain with preference rules. Metrics: queue_len, queue_wait_histogram, accepted_from_queue.

tasha: Concern: queueing increases tail latency and could violate our <250ms SLO for sync requests. Some clients are blocking and will timeout before queue drains. Need to consider async retry guidance.

devinfra-bot: deploy-check: feature flag 'microburst-grace' exists in staging. Canary rollout % can be controlled from console.

sam: Proposal sketch — leaky smoother + short grace queue between LB and admission control. Config example: 

```yaml
admission:
  per_key:
    rate: 10/s
    burst: 30
    grace_queue:
      enabled: true
      max_items: 200
      max_wait_ms: 5000
leaky_smoother:
  window_ms: 200
  max_drain_per_window: 8
```

This should let very short spikes pass while bounding sustained load.

maria: +1 to the config idea. Also add telemetry counters: accepted_from_bucket, accepted_from_queue, rejected_total. Dashboard should surface queue_wait_p50/p95/p99 and drop_rate_by_org/key.

liam: Add a synthetic probe to canary: emit 60s spike every hour so we can validate behavior vs SLOs in staging and track regressions.

anita: Operational note — when queue drains prefer borrowing from org-level token pool before rejecting a single key. Fallback policy: if org has headroom, borrow up to X tokens per key for Y seconds, then revert.

tasha: UX ask: in Console rollout modal show a simple toggle "Microburst grace (queue)" with short explanation and an estimate of expected request latency/cost uplift if enabled. Also expose per-route defaults.

ops-bot: Incident logged INC-2026 "microburst-503s" — linking logs and traces.

sam: Implementation plan: 1) add leaky smoother + grace queue in ingress, 2) emit new metrics, 3) add unit+e2e tests, 4) add canary feature flag, 5) dashboard tile + runbook. Owner: @sam. Reviewers: @liam, @maria. ETA: 3d for initial PR; 24h canary at 10% then ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy planned for staging branch 'ingress/microburst-smoother' — CI green.

maria: Thanks — also please add runbook steps for when queue fills (how to temporarily disable queue, how to increase max_wait, scripts to drain, and how to force 429s for abused keys).

liam: sgtm. I'll add the synthetic probe harness.

anita: I'll own the dashboard tile (queue_wait_p99, accept_source_split, drop_by_org).

tasha: I'll wire up the console toggle copy and the rollout docs blurb.

sam: Cool, I'll open the PR and tag folks. Let's ensure telemetry emits a 1-min and 5-min rollup for alerts.

maria: Great work. Follow-up in thread once PR is ready. :thumbsup:
